# SpartanUI

SpartanUI (SUI) was originally designed to free your screen by moving a majority of the interface elements to the bottom. While that is still the core focus of the primary addon and configuration it has become much more. Spartan UI has become completely modular and has added many new features over the years. Thanks to the modules you can use only the parts of SUI that you want to give you untimate control over your interface.

---

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Patreon-Donate-important?style=for-the-badge&logo=Patreon)](https://www.patreon.com/SpartanUI)
[![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/spartanui-wow/SpartanUI?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/spartanui-wow/SpartanUI/issues)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/265564257347829771.svg?logo=discord&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/Qc9TRBv)
[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/release/spartanui-wow/spartanui.svg?&style=for-the-badge)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/spartan-ui)
[![Package and release](https://img.shields.io/github/workflow/status/spartanui-wow/SpartanUI/Package%20and%20release?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/spartanui-wow/SpartanUI/actions)
[![YouTube](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Youtube-red?style=for-the-badge&logo=youtube)](https://www.youtube.com/@wutname1Gaming/)

---

If you have a spare 2 minutes please take a moment to let me know what game version you play and what Skin you use [https://forms.office.com/r/pVfXCKKd0p](https://forms.office.com/r/pVfXCKKd0p) This will help me know what to focus on

**Overview**

SpartanUI is designed to free your screen by moving a majority of the interface elements to the bottom.

- Artwork
- Player Frames
- Party Frames
- Raid Frames
- HoT Tracking
- Auto Sell
- Auto turn in
- Auto-Hide Objectives
- Custom Tooltips
- Minimap
- Buff Management
- Open All Mail
- Vignette Effects
- And much more!

**Notes**

- Please submit bugs and feature requests at [GitHub.](https://github.com/spartanui-wow/SpartanUI/issues)
- For Support please join the [SpartanUI Discord](https://discord.gg/Qc9TRBv) or join one of the SpartanUI [Dev Streams on Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/wutname1)

**Action Bars**

SpartanUI draws its own action bars on every game version. [Bartender4](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/bartender4) is still supported if you prefer it, and your Bartender4, ElvUI or Dominos bar setup can be imported from the Bar System options.

Chat Commands

- /sui (Main options window) **See a [list of all](https://github.com/spartanui-wow/SpartanUI/wiki/Slash-Commands) commands on the [Github Wiki](https://github.com/spartanui-wow/SpartanUI/wiki/Slash-Commands)**

**F.A.Q**

**Q. I changed an option but nothing changed.**

**A.** Some of the options for require a /reload to be done after changing them. This is something that is being worked on to reduce the need for and will be soon prompting for when it must be done.

## Additional Addons

- [Chinese Font](http://www.curse.com/addons/wow/spartanui-chinese-font/)
- [Fun Fact](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/funfact)

# SpartanUI Changelog

## 📅 Last Month Summary

This update fixes many issues for WoW Forever, improving how the minimap, unit frames, and action bars look and work. We also fixed errors with glowing buttons, nameplates, and chat reporting. You can now hide or resize the text on buff and debuff icons, and WoW Forever players can switch profiles automatically with dual spec.

## 🎯 This Release

This update fixes several issues for WoW Forever players, including minimap display, action button errors, and how combo points update. Nameplates also now correctly track tanks during group changes.

## Version 9.0.5 (2026-11-14)

### 🐛 Fixes
- The Fel look's minimap sits in its ring on WoW Forever
- You can turn off the minimap clock, coordinates and zone text on WoW Forever
- No more error spam from glowing action buttons on WoW Forever
- Nameplates keep knowing who your tanks are when the group changes mid-fight
- Rogue and druid combo points on WoW Forever follow your current target

### 📝 Changes
- Unit frames updated to the latest version, with fixes for WoW Forever

## Version 9.0.4 (2026-11-12)

### 🐛 Fixes
- Logging in no longer stalls with a "script ran too long" error from unit frames
- Player and target frames stay on the Voyager, Grove and Observatory artwork after a reload

## Version 9.0.3 (2026-11-10)

### 🚀 Features
- WoW Forever players can switch profiles automatically with dual spec
- Hide or resize the timer and stack numbers on buff and debuff icons

### 🐛 Fixes
- The keyring button on the bag bar no longer shows up sideways on WoW Forever
- 3D portraits fade out with the rest of the interface
- Mind Flay and Penance cast bars show the right number of tick marks
- The minimap keeps its round or square shape on WoW Forever when map rotation changes
- You can report Battle.net friends from Messenger too
- Choosing a quest reward no longer causes an error on WoW Forever
- You can report players again from the chat window and Messenger
- Action bars and the micro menu line up with the artwork on WoW Forever
- The shaman totem bar no longer fights with Bartender4 on WoW Forever
- Combo points on WoW Forever now match your current target
- 3D portraits now fade out with the rest of the unit frame

### 📝 Changes
- Incoming heal predictions updated for Classic Era and Season of Discovery
- The button glow library for WoW 12.1
- Map and zone data updated for every game version, WoW Forever included
- The library that adjusts Edit Mode frames, for WoW Forever
- The shared fonts and textures library
- Minimap button updated for the latest game versions
- The tooltip library used for list pop-ups
- Range checks on WoW Forever no longer break in combat
- Settings and profiles work better on WoW Forever

## Version 9.0.2 (2026-11-04)

### 🐛 Fixes
- Minimap zone text, clock and buttons are back in their places on WoW Forever

## Version 9.0.1 (2026-11-04)

### 🐛 Fixes
- Loot roll windows keep the spot you moved them to
- Tooltips show first and last names properly on WoW Forever
- Interrupt announcements, taunt alerts and kill stats keep working on newer game versions
- The zone bar and minimap buttons sit in the right place on WoW Forever
- Last Tick follows your damage over time spells again on Retail and WoW Forever
- Nameplate aura timers show a short number instead of the word Seconds
- Party frames no longer disappear when a mythic+ key starts

### 📝 Changes
- You can ping spells on your action bars, and the bars do less work in the background
- Unit frames updated to the latest version, and arena frames show class colors before the match

---

### 🚀 Features

### 🐛 Fixes

- Nameplates no longer cause errors or slow down big pulls

### 📝 Changes
- The info bar under the minimap is turned off for now
- The old nameplates are retired, and your plate and text sizes move to the new ones

## Version 8.2.2 (2026-10-11)

### 🐛 Fixes
- The Midnight, Grid and flat looks no longer show an error on Classic

## Version 8.2.1 (2026-10-10)

### 🚀 Features
- Preview chats from the Messenger icon and add handy info bars
- Choose colorful chat bubbles and avoid addon conflicts
- Shard and Lamina, two modern takes on the Classic look
- Every SpartanUI look now has its own painted info bar
- See when your damage over time spells will finish off your target

### 🐛 Fixes
- Hiding buff icons for phased or out-of-range group members no longer causes errors
- Logs, import, export and what's new now open in front of the settings window
- Scaling the minimap in move mode now scales the map itself, and moved frames no longer drift while you scale them
- The DoT damage marker now shows at the right size
- New characters no longer share settings on their first login
- Setup opens for new characters again

### 📝 Changes
- The settings window now comes with Lib's AddonTools, so your other Lib's addons can use the same look (update Lib's AddonTools too)
- Tribal's painted info bar art
- Unit frames updated to the latest oUF, with fixes for WoW Forever
- Highlight your target, focus or mouseover on party and raid frames, and on boss and arena frames
